english.title: Purchase / offer to purchase etc / sell / keep for sale etc specimen of species listed in Annex A

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: control of trade in endangered species enforcement regulations 1997

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 8(1) and (8) of the Control of Trade in Endangered Species (Enforcement) Regulations 1997
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
purchased / offered to purchase / acquired for commercial purposes / used for commercial gain / sold / kept for sale / offered for sale / transported for sale
specimen of species listed in Annex A of the Principal Regulation (No 338/97)

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence should not be used for acts carried out after 30th September 2018; the Control of Trade in Endangered Species (Enforcement) Regulations 1997 are revoked by the Control of Trade in Endangered Species Regulations 2018 (SI 2018/703) from 1st October 2018.
(ii) This regulation does not apply to anything done under, and in accordance with the terms of, any certificate or general derogation granted pursuant to Article 8 of the Principal Regulation (338/97) - regulation 8(3).
(iii) A person shall not be guilty of an offence under this regulation if he proves that at the time the alleged offence was committed he had no reason to believe that the specimen was a specimen of the species listed in Annex A - regulation 8(4).

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale
Indictment: Five years imprisonment and / or a fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
